Layer-by-layer rotation: 4-way swap. O(n^2) in place.

For rotate matrix 90 cw I will iterate layer by layer, doing 4-way swaps to rotate corners inward.

```python
def rotate(mat):
    n = len(mat)
    for layer in range(n // 2):
        first, last = layer, n - layer - 1
        for i in range(first, last):
            offset = i - first
            top = mat[first][i]
            mat[first][i] = mat[last - offset][first]
            mat[last - offset][first] = mat[last][last - offset]
            mat[last][last - offset] = mat[i][last]
            mat[i][last] = top
    return mat
```
